definitions.gloss: karate, the way of the empty hand
definitions.explanation: A Japanese martial art originating from Okinawa that emphasizes striking techniques using punches, kicks, knee strikes, and open-hand techniques. The formal name for what is commonly called 空手.

examples.japanese: {空手道|からてどう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{学|まな}んでいる→学ぶ：01987_manabu⟧。
{空手道|からてどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{沖縄|おきなわ}→沖縄：11009_okinawa⟧⟦{発祥|はっしょう}→発祥：13630_hasshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{武道|ぶどう}→武道：09640_budou⟧だ。
examples.english: Karate is a martial art originating from Okinawa.

examples.japanese: {空手道|からてどう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧2020⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦オリンピック→オリンピック：09899_orinpikku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{正式種目|せいしきしゅもく}になった。
examples.english: Karate became an official event at the 2020 Tokyo Olympics.

notes:
FORMS:
⟦{空|から}→空：27640_kara⟧ (empty) + ⟦{手|て}→手：00569_te⟧ (hand) + {道|どう} (way/path)

The name means "the way of the empty hand," reflecting that it is primarily an unarmed martial art.

USAGE:
{空手道|からてどう} is the formal name. In everyday conversation, ⟦{空手|からて}→空手：04454_karate⟧ is more commonly used. The ～{道|どう} suffix emphasizes it as a disciplined path of self-improvement, not just a fighting technique.

MAJOR STYLES:
- {松濤館流|しょうとうかんりゅう} (Shotokan)
- {剛柔流|ごうじゅうりゅう} (Goju-ryu)
- {糸東流|しとうりゅう} (Shito-ryu)
- {和道流|わどうりゅう} (Wado-ryu)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {空手道|からてどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{道場|どうじょう}→道場：14326_doujou⟧: karate dojo
- {空手道|からてどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{型|かた}→型：02146_kata⟧: karate forms
- {空手道|からてどう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{黒帯|くろおび}→黒帯：14938_kuroobi⟧: karate black belt
